   The Bridge Committee


Level 4 · Mastery       Ages 13–15         Story + Workbook




       JurassicEnglish.com · Storybook workbook edition

Chapter 1


1       Seven chairs




The committee had seven chairs, seven voting cards and a rule everyone
admired: each person could speak for exactly two minutes.
Rafi joined as the school representative. The town wanted a small footbridge
linking the library garden to the festival square. His art club had painted the
first model.
At the opening meeting, the chair asked whether anyone objected to the
rules. Nobody did. The minutes recorded unanimous agreement.
A caretaker named Len arrived after the vote, carrying the keys from his
evening shift. There was no eighth chair. Rafi moved his own slightly
sideways, but the meeting had already begun.


Read and circle
What did the minutes record after the chair asked whether anyone objected to the
rules?

           A. That Len had objected to the rule

           B. That the art club would vote on the design

           C. Unanimous agreement from all members
